hero.subtitle: Iqonga elipheleleyo elinezisombululo zewebhu kunye neeselfowuni zokusasazwa, ukuthengisa, ukuhanjiswa, ukuthenga, uluhlu lwempahla, imali kunye nokunye.

products_block.title: A [[ecosystem epheleleyo]] kwindawo nganye yeshishini lakho

products_page.title: Iimveliso ezisixhenxe, [[umsebenzi omnye]]
products_page.text: Imveliso nganye isombulula indawo. Bebonke babelana ngabathengi, isitokhwe, iiodolo kunye neentlawulo.

fullvendor.card: Iqonga eliphambili lolawulo lwentengiso kunye nokuhanjiswa.
fullvendor.lead: Iziko lomsebenzi wakho worhwebo: iiodolo, amaxabiso, isitokhwe kunye nabathengi kwindawo enye.
fullvendor.about: FullVendor ithatha indawo yesipredishithi esikhululekileyo somthengisi kunye neenkqubo. Ukusuka apha kuphuma iiodolo, kujongwe uluhlu lwempahla, ipotifoliyo yabathengi iyakhathalelwa kwaye amanani osuku ayajongwa. Intsalela ye-ikhosistim iqhagamshela kwesi siseko.

benefits.title: Inkosi yedatha enye
benefits.text: Abathengi, iimveliso kunye namaxabiso kwabelwana ngazo kunye neentengiso, indawo yokugcina impahla kunye nemali.

benefits.title: Sula umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla
benefits.text: Iiodolo, ukuthengwa kunye nesitokhwe siyeke ukuhlala kwiifayile ezahlukeneyo.

benefits.title: Iingxelo zokugqiba
benefits.text: Ukuthengisa, umda kunye nokulinda kubonwa ngaphandle kokudibanisa itafile ngesandla.

benefits.title: Ukulungele ukukhula
benefits.text: Ulungiselelo, amandla okuthengisa okanye ERP iimali xa umsebenzi uyicela.

fullvendor.audience: Amaqela okurhweba kunye nokuhanjiswa namhlanje alungelelanisa ishishini phakathi kweenkqubo ezininzi.

erp.lead: Ulawulo kunye neemali, ezihambelana noko kuthengiswa ngokwenene kunye nokuhanjiswa.
erp.about: FullVendor ERP ibandakanya i-accounting, i-invoyisi ye-elektroniki, ii-payrolls, ii-asethi ezisisigxina kunye neenkampani ezininzi. Ithatha umsebenzi worhwebo kwaye uyiguqule ibe ngamangenelo, iirisithi kunye neengxelo ezinokuthi zisetyenziswe ummandla wemali.

benefits.title: Ubalo-mali oluqhagamshelweyo
benefits.text: Kwenzeka ntoni kwiintengiso kunye nokuthengwa kwe-accounting.

benefits.title: Iirisithi zombane
benefits.text: Ukhupha kwaye ulawule ukuhlawuliswa kwe-ecosystem efanayo.

benefits.title: Iinkampani ezahlukeneyo

benefits.title: Iintlawulo kunye nee-asethi

erp.audience: Iindawo zolawulo kunye nezemali ezifuna ukuvala amanani kunye nokusebenza kwangempela.

logistics.card: Ukulawula kunye nokubeka esweni umsebenzi wakho wolungiselelo.
logistics.lead: Ukusuka kwi-odolo ukuya ekuhanjisweni: iindlela, abaqhubi kunye nokulandelwa kwexesha langempela.

points: Qala ngabaxumi, iimveliso kunye namaxabiso: bangutitshala osetyenziswa ngumntu wonke.
Qhagamshela iodolo nesitokhwe phambi kokuba wongeze ezinye izicelo.
Ilinganisa inani elilula: imiyalelo ezalisekileyo ngaphandle kokwenza kwakhona ifom.

offline.summary: Yintoni efunekayo kwi-app yoku-odola ukwenzela ukuba umthengisi angayeki ngenxa yesignali.
points: Ikhathalogu kunye ne-wallet kufuneka ibe kwifowuni, kungekhona nje kwifu.
Iodolo igcinwa kwisixhobo kwaye ilayishwe xa inethiwekhi ibuya.
Xa ungqamaniso, umyalelo sele ungenile kwindawo yokugcina impahla.

points: Fumana ngokuchasene nomyalelo wokuthenga, hayi ngokuchasene nememori.
Qinisekisa into nganye xa usahlula. Ibug isika epasejini.

finance.title: Ingqokelela ehambelana nentengiso
finance.summary: Kutheni umthengisi kufuneka abone ityala lomthengi ngaphambi kokuba athathe enye iodolo.
points: Ukutyelela lixesha elifanelekileyo lokuqokelela, ukuba ityala liyabonakala.
Ukuthengisa kunye nemali kufuneka kujonge kumthengi ofanayo.
Ingxelo yemihla ngemihla ixabiseke ngaphezu kokuvala kade.

legal.privacy_intro: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uchaza into esiyenzayo ngedatha oyishiyayo kwiifom kule ndawo.

privacy.title: Yiyiphi idatha esiyiqokelelayo
privacy.text: Ukuba ucela idemo okanye usibhalele, sigcina igama, inkampani, i-imeyile, inombolo yomnxeba ukuba uyayibonisa, ilizwe, ubungakanani beqela, imveliso yomdla kunye nomyalezo. Siphinde sirekhode umhla, ulwimi lwephepha kunye nedilesi ye-IP, ukuthintela ukungeniswa kakubi.

privacy.title: Sizisebenzisela ntoni?
privacy.text: Sisebenzisa le datha kuphela ukuphendula kuwe, ukulungelelanisa idemo kunye nokulungiselela isiphakamiso sorhwebo. Asizithengisi okanye sizinike uluhlu lwamaqela esithathu.

privacy.title: Zigcinwa phi kwaye ixesha elingakanani?
privacy.text: Izicelo zigcinwe kwiseva yale sayithi. Sizigcinela ixesha eliyimfuneko ukuze sikukhonze kunye nokulandelelwa kwezorhwebo, kwaye siyazicima xa usicela okanye xa zingasafuneki.

privacy.title: Amalungelo akho
privacy.text: Unokucela ukufikelela, ukulungiswa okanye ukucinywa kwedatha yakho kwifom yoqhagamshelwano, eyibonisa kumyalezo. Ukuba inkampani ipapasha i-imeyile kule webhusayithi, ungabhala nalapho.

legal.terms_intro: Le miqathango isebenza ekusebenziseni le FullVendor indawo yokungenisa.

terms.title: Ulwazi lwezorhwebo
terms.text: Izicatshulwa, umzekelo amanani edeshibhodi kunye neenkcazo zazisa iqonga. Ziyakwazi ukulungelelaniswa xa imveliso itshintsha kwaye ayingomnikelo ovaliweyo.

terms.title: Idemo ayisosivumelwano
terms.text: Ukungenisa ifomu akubangeli xanduva lokuthenga okanye ukugcina ixabiso. Nayiphi na ikhontrakthi kuvunyelwene ngayo ngokwahlukeneyo, ngokubhaliweyo, kunye nemida yayo kunye nemiqathango.

terms.title: Umxholo wesayithi
terms.text: I FullVendor uphawu lwentengiso, amagama emveliso kunye nomxholo wala maphepha ngabanini bawo. Azinakukhutshelwa ukubonisa enye imveliso.

terms.title: Ukusetyenziswa okwamkelekileyo
terms.text: Musa ukusebenzisa iifom ukungenisa ulwazi olungeyonyani, ugaxekile okanye umxholo ongekho mthethweni. Sisenokungazihoyi izicelo ezingahambelaniyo nencoko yokwenyani yeshishini.
